source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: The native RestoreSortInfo path clears secondary sorting for kGroupBySort, and getSortStatusFromView exposes only the primary for grouped views. New folders also need an initial sort-column entry when no saved columns exist. This adds native persistence detail to the existing grouped-sort rule; it does not mean a valid primary should be rejected because an old secondary is invalid.
title: Discard persisted secondary sort when restoring a grouped view
